notes: Read SKILL.md in full (single-file skill). Guide to Cloudflare Workers with Wrangler: scaffolding, dev/deploy/rollback, wrangler.toml configuration, API router and KV rate-limit examples, KV, D1, cron triggers, Durable Objects, routing and troubleshooting.

Medium: following it has the agent install Wrangler globally and scaffold with `npm create cloudflare@latest` (SKILL.md:25, 33), log in to the user's Cloudflare account, deploy and roll back Workers to production (SKILL.md:43, 72), set secrets via an interactive prompt (SKILL.md:56-57), write KV keys and run D1 SQL against the user's databases (SKILL.md:236-290). Acceptable because these are the standard Wrangler workflow for the user's own Worker; secrets are entered by the user at the prompt, not read or printed. Users should confirm production deploys and rollbacks.

Example IDs and example.com hosts are placeholders. Related Skills (SKILL.md:397-399) link to sibling skills ../cloudflare-pages/, ../cloudflare-r2/, ../cloudflare-zero-trust/ that do not ship; optional pointers. Frontmatter declares license: MIT.
